title: Synthetic canary harness and stateful replay adapter for deterministic rollbacks
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Adds a synthetic-canary harness and a stateful replay adapter to capture session-level context for deterministic rollback testing. Enables CI replay of real traffic windows and safe rollbacks with preserved KV cache/state.
description: Context: intermittent regressions observed in production canaries are hard to reproduce due to transient session state and KV cache differences. This PR introduces a synthetic canary harness that can generate deterministically-sampled traffic windows and a stateful replay adapter that records and replays session/KV cache artifacts so rollbacks and fixes can be validated locally and in CI. Changes include a lightweight traffic generator, a pluggable replay adapter that snapshots and restores per-session KV cache and model input fingerprints, and CI playback jobs that run recorded windows against candidate and baseline model variants. The description below lists motivation, design, tests, and rollout strategy.
